question: Validation passes as specified but --config still routes an unlisted name to a drafting backend: fix that before the PR, or ship with it noted?

artifacts.summary: Fourth validation passes every item by running code: the lead gate reads the configuration the engine resolved, proven against the old failure; the two CLIs share one backend list, so neither holds a literal; every previously valid invocation parses identically; the completeness check fails on an undriven choice. One material defect survives outside the criteria: --config validates keys only, so an unlisted translation_backend resolves through core to nllw and reports a null lead beside a drafting translator.
